objective: Select the minimum-cost provider for Jan-2026 historical universe, later-delisted securities, and raw/unadjusted OHLCV.

selection.reason: Official documentation states Stocks Basic includes 2 years of historical aggregate bars and reference data; Jan-2026 is inside that window as of 2026-10-23. All Tickers supports a historical date and includes later-delisted companies; REST aggregate bars can be requested with adjusted=false for raw split-unadjusted OHLCV. Basic is rate-limited to 5 API calls/minute and has no flat files.
selection.important_expiry: The Basic 2-year history window rolls forward. Jan-2026 data must be acquired and frozen before it ages out of the entitlement window. Store immutable local/repository-safe derived snapshots, not credentials.

massive.historical_universe: Historical All Tickers date query; later-delisted companies included according to official documentation
massive.raw_volume: Supported through unadjusted aggregate request; live stress test still required

eodhd.rate_limit: 100000 calls/day, 1000 requests/minute on published paid plan
eodhd.delisted: Supported; after-2018 delistings include EOD plus fundamentals/dividends/splits per docs
eodhd.historical_universe: Requires reconstruction by merging active/delisted plus listing/delisting/symbol-change metadata; no direct dated-universe endpoint verified
eodhd.raw_ohlc: Default OHLC documented as raw/unadjusted for splits/dividends
eodhd.raw_volume: Not sufficiently verified for our reverse-split raw-volume requirement

sharadar.pricing: Premium; public documentation requires login to view pricing
sharadar.delisted: Active and delisted US stocks covered
sharadar.historical_universe: Strong research metadata but direct historical universe snapshot semantics not verified as native PIT
sharadar.raw_ohlc: Primary open/high/low/close fields are split-adjusted; closeunadj is raw close; full raw OHLC requires imputation/reconstruction
sharadar.raw_volume: Primary volume is split-adjusted; raw volume requires reconstruction
sharadar.identity: Strong research reference data; Permaticker supported in Sharadar ecosystem

decision: Do not purchase a provider yet. Create a free Massive Stocks Basic account/API key and execute the previously specified M1-M10 live coverage test. If it passes, freeze Jan-2026 universe and raw OHLCV while inside the rolling two-year entitlement. Upgrade to Starter only if rate limits/flat-file throughput materially block acquisition.
